description: A yellow tabletop fills the foreground with a light blue cleaning cloth on it, and a small spray bottle is held nearby against a plain fabric backdrop. The left hand presses the cloth against the surface and wipes in short strokes back and forth and slightly downward, while the right hand holds the spray bottle above the table, angling and repositioning it without spraying; the cloth is the left-hand object and the bottle is the right-hand object.
